abstract: Serial computed tomographic (CT) scans of 200 patients with malignant testicular teratomas were reviewed. Of the 200 patients, 120 were treated with chemotherapy for metastatic disease; 80 patients with no evidence of metastases (stage I disease) received no treatment and served as a control group. CT was performed at regular intervals for ongoing follow-up in both groups. Thymic enlargement occurred 3-14 months after initiation of treatment in 14 of the 120 patients (11.6%) who received chemotherapy but in only one patient in the control group. Histologic examination in one patient who received chemotherapy revealed that the thymic enlargement represented true hyperplasia. Thirteen of the 14 patients (93%) with thymic enlargement after chemotherapy were well and disease free on mean follow-up of 45 months, compared with 78% of the group that did not show thymic enlargement after chemotherapy (P less than .02). Rebound thymic hyperplasia in adults after chemotherapy for metastatic testicular teratoma may be a good prognostic feature and should be considered when an anterior mediastinal mass develops after chemotherapy for metastatic malignancy.
abstract_ja: 悪性精巣奇形腫の患者200例の連続コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)画像を検討した。このうち120例は転移性疾患に対して化学療法を受け、病期I 80例は治療を受けず対照群とした。化学療法を受けた120例中14例(11.6%)で治療後3〜14か月に胸腺増大が出現したが、対照群では1例のみであった。化学療法後に胸腺増大を認めた1例の組織学的検査で、真の過形成であることが確認された。胸腺増大を認めた14例中13例(93%)は、平均45か月のフォローアップ期間中、無病で良好に経過していた。胸腺増大を認めなかった群では78%であった(P<.02)。成人における化学療法後のリバウンド胸腺過形成は良好な予後因子となりうる可能性があり、転移性悪性腫瘍の化学療法後に前縦隔腫瘤が出現した際には考慮すべきである。
